case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to the alloy and bar-stock costs behind your quote, so we looked at the same lines and at what a longer commitment is worth to a family foundry like yours.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Option A is the package we can approve: a contract term that gives your capacity a planned base, with payment terms that suit both sides.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you will want to check it internally, please take Option A to the person who decides on your side.

To help us settle this properly:
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the index developments you cited, which allows us to adjust our pricing.

Our offer provides a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While our detailed cost structures are proprietary and cannot be shared, we are pleased to offer the requested 24-month term and 45-day payment. However, a 24-month commitment requires the AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility, bringing our offer to €5.40 per unit.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

They also give you a fixed volume of reliable business from a long-standing customer.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.27; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.29; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.33; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longer term you asked for at a clear price, and the delivery record above is a good reason for us to settle the price at this level.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since price changes may need sign-off on your side, please take Option A to the person who decides, so that the answer can be a simple yes.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the delivery record you cited and, as a gesture of goodwill, can adjust our price to €5.30 per unit. We are pleased to accept your proposed 45-day payment terms and 24-month contract duration. However, as previously stated, a 24-month commitment requires the AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot offer a fixed price over this period.

It is always our pleasure to support your inventory needs from our extensive stock with our reliable service. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked about volume, and that is exactly what our options give a family foundry like yours: a binding volume in every option, over the full contract term, which fills your capacity with reliable business.

These options take another route: the base price is set without any clause, so neither side has to carry or manage that risk during the term.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.17; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.19; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.23; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It combines the binding volume with the payment term you have already accepted, at a price that works for both family companies. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As inside sales, you may need to clear this internally. Could you take Option A to the person who decides on your side? Options B and C are there if a longer payment term suits you better.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We note your proposal of a binding volume of 23,700 units per year; please provide the underlying data to substantiate this projection. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

Following internal consultation as you requested, we are pleased to reduce our price to €5.20 per unit for a 24-month term with 45-day payment terms. To support the 24-month contract duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot fix prices over this period. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our Angebot is a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.20 per unit.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and the answer is in our proposal below: a binding volume over the full contract term, which gives your capacity reliable business.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 5.20; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

We call this Option A, the package we can approve. If you confirm it as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
